leases.focus: ONE-SHOT TEAM V2 ACCEPTANCE: produce one evidence-backed control-plane acceptance result proving Admission -> Reservation -> Worker -> Branch Preservation -> Independent QC -> Persisted QC -> Integration -> Target Promotion -> Memory Closure. No product implementation, no charter/architecture changes, no reopening accepted F1-F6/CCC/UX work, no changes outside the lease result directory. The acceptance report must explicitly assess the real control-plane hardening now present, including whether a worker result remains recoverable after validation failure, whether QC inspects the actual worker patch, and whether promotion is fail-closed on missing persisted QC.
leases.purpose: Team V2 end-to-end acceptance gate before broad product continuation.
leases.value: Decides whether autonomous team construction is safe to continue.
